title: The full actual winding sector is finite-scope controlled
statement: Connected-pin partition separates one from at least three parallel moving walls, paying all other loops and both endpoint fibers. The sharper existential union needs one actual diagonal wall shorter2.5L, with the complementary global winding tail. Final exactly-two-diagonal occupation exponents are47/440/3196/34695. Combining axis/topology bounds controls every state with at least one essential wall at R1000/10000 by exp(-137/-4355), not at both smaller tuples from these constants. Zero-essential coverage is supplied only by the later separate theorem.
